YouTube Music is a music streaming service developed by YouTube, a subsidiary of Google. It allows users to explore music audios and music videos from YouTube-based genres, playlists, and recommendations.

You can find more information about YouTube Music, including its features, pricing for Music Premium, and links to download the app on Google Play and the App Store, by visiting the following URLs:

  • Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/YouTube_Music
  • Google Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.google.android.apps.youtube.music
  • App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/youtube-music/id1017492454
  • YouTube Music Premium: https://www.youtube.com/musicpremium
  • YouTube Music (main website): https://music.youtube.com/
